name: Adobe Lightroom
note: This profile covers Adobe Lightroom Classic as well as Lightroom: the match rules list both Lightroom.exe and LightroomClassic.exe, so there is no separate lightroom_classic entry. Default bindings hand-authored 2026-09-04; the full shortcut list comes from the ShortcutMapper import in reference/app-shortcuts.json, and every row of Adobe's own "Keyboard shortcuts for Lightroom Classic" help page (last updated Oct 29, 2025) has been merged in on top of it. The context is the Adobe section's module when the section names one - Book module, Library module (the "comparing photos" and "metadata and keywords" tables), Develop module, Slideshow module, Print module, Map module, Web module - plus Secondary window for the second-monitor table; the app-wide tables (working with panels, navigating modules, changing views and screen modes, managing photos and catalogs, rating and filtering photos, working with collections, using Help) get an empty context. Adobe rows that pack two commands into one line with a slash are split into two actions (Go back / Go forward, Zoom in / Zoom out, Increase / Decrease brush size, Copy / Paste metadata, and so on), keeping Adobe's wording for each half. Rows that list a run of keys or alternative keys for one command become one action per key with that key's Windows chord in parentheses after the name: the panel-opening digit ranges (Ctrl+Shift+0-5, Ctrl+0-9, Ctrl+1-7), star ratings 1-5, colour labels 6-9, the keyword-set Alt+1-9 row, and the alternative keys for Switch to Loupe view, Switch to Grid view, Switch from Grid to Loupe view, Delete selected photo(s), Deselect all photos and Toggle between Loupe and 1:1 Zoom preview. Left out because the chord grammar cannot express them: every mouse row (Toggle solo mode, Open a new panel without closing soloed panel, Open/close all panels, Select multiple folders or collections, Select multiple discrete/contiguous photos, Open multiple filters in the Filter bar, Reset a slider, Reset a group of sliders, Toggle Auto Sync, Crop from center of photo, Temporarily switch from brush A or B to Eraser, Paint a horizontal or vertical line, Increase/decrease Amount, Hide current module shortcuts); "Cycle through variations of Generative Remove", which Adobe writes only as "Alt + Side arrow keys"; and the macOS-only "Open Spelling dialog box" (Command + :), whose colon is not a key the grammar admits. Adobe's "Page Up / Page Down on full-size keyboard" rows are kept as PageUp / PageDown. Rows Adobe marks n/a on one platform are emitted for the other platform only (Redo (Windows only), Previous screen mode, E-mail photos). The enhance and merge rows (Headless enhance, Open enhance dialog box, HDR merge, Headless HDR merge, Pano merge, Headless pano merge) keep the literal Control key Adobe documents for macOS rather than substituting Command.
